messages.author: d329fe17400b6f1b
messages.subject: Inconsistency in estimated covariance
parts:
Hi,

I have a model where two LVs have just one indicator. My reasoning was that the covariance between them should be the same no matter whether they are just correlated factors in the model, or whether they are endogenous variables in a SEM. However, the covariance changes and I don't really understand why... I've put some example code below. I guess there's a specific reason for why lavaan behaves like this but I couldn't figure it out really...

Any help is appreciated. Pete


set.seed(123)

library(lavaan)
library(semPlot)

N <- 1000
Is <- rnorm(N, mean=5)

dat <- data.frame(x1 = Is * 0.35 + runif(N),
                  x2 = Is * 0.30 + runif(N),
                  x3 = Is * 0.25 + runif(N),
                  x4 = Is * 0.20 + runif(N),
                  x5 = Is * 0.15 + runif(N))

dat$y1 <- Is * 0.35 + runif(N)
dat$y2 <- Is * 0.25 + runif(N)

dat <- apply(dat, 2, scale)

round(cor(dat), 2)
# => correlation matrix between y1 and y2 = .51

# first model with correlated factors
str1 <- '
IV =~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5
DV1 =~ 1*y1
DV2 =~ 1*y2
'
m1 <- sem(str1, data=dat, std.lv=TRUE, estimator="ML")
semPaths(m1, layout="tree2", whatLabel="est", intercepts=T, thresholds=T, residuals=T, exoCov=T, title=F, legend=F, mar=c(6,4,6,4))
summary(m1)
# => the covariance between DV1 and DV2 is .51 as in the correlation matrix shown above

round(cor(predict(m1)), 2)
# => the correlation between the predicted factor values for DV1 and DV2 is .51


# second model with some regressions (SEM)
str2 <- '
IV =~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5
DV1 =~ 1*y1
DV2 =~ 1*y2
DV1 ~ IV
DV2 ~ IV
'
m2 <- sem(str2, data=dat, std.lv=TRUE, estimator="ML")
semPaths(m2, layout="tree2", whatLabel="est", intercepts=T, thresholds=T, residuals=T, exoCov=T, title=F, legend=F, mar=c(6,4,6,4))
summary(m2)
# => now the covariance between DV1 and DV2 dropped to .37. Why?

round(cor(predict(m2)), 2)
# => when I predict factor scores, the correlation between DV1 and DV2 is still .51...

# How can I get the correlation of .51 show as covariance between DV1 and DV2 (in model 2) when using a semPaths illustration?

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Inconsistency in estimated covariance
parts:
Pete

I dont think these are not inconsistent results.

The first model estimates the correlation between DV1 and DV2
While the second model estimates the conditional correlation between DV1 and DV2, so it is their correlation controlling for IV
